description: Panorama on the M-100 and M-500 provides centralized management and visibility of multiple Palo Alto Networks next-generation firewalls and supports distributed management and logging functions. It allows you to oversee all applications, users, and content traversing the network and then create application enablement policies that protect and control the entire network. The M-500 provides an additional service, the PAN-DB private cloud, which is an on-premise solution suitable for organizations that prohibit or restrict the use of the PAN-DB public cloud service.
